## Summary
- Resolve `@sepo-agent /install owner/repo` as the `install` route while still running the bundled `install-agent` skill.
- Apply `AGENT_ACCESS_POLICY.route_overrides.install` independently from general `/skill` access.
- Update install docs and skill guidance with route-policy examples and clear post-merge onboarding todos.

## Notes
- This intentionally does not add `AGENT_INSTALL_PAT`, fork creation, or cross-repo PR mechanics.
- Builds on #273.

## Verification
- `npm --prefix .agent run build`
- `node --test .agent/dist/__tests__/triage.test.js .agent/dist/__tests__/resolve-dispatch-cli.test.js .agent/dist/__tests__/extract-context-cli.test.js .agent/dist/__tests__/envelope.test.js .agent/dist/__tests__/rubrics.test.js`

- `git diff --check`

Closes #279

- No rubric-specific follow-up needed beyond ensuring the listed verification commands stay green before merge.

## Summary of PR/Issue
PR #281 makes `@sepo-agent /install owner/repo` resolve as a first-class `install` route while still executing the bundled `install-agent` skill. This lets `AGENT_ACCESS_POLICY.route_overrides.install` restrict external install requests independently from general `/skill` access. The PR builds on #273’s install parsing and structured target plumbing, and it closes the route-policy child task from #279 under parent #277. It intentionally leaves `AGENT_INSTALL_PAT`, fork creation, and cross-repo PR mechanics for later focused work.

## Review
The current reviewer artifacts support shipping this PR. The only reviewer disagreement is a non-blocking maintainability suggestion to add an explicit `install` branch in `applyDispatchPolicy`; current behavior is equivalent through the shared fallback and covered by route-override tests.

| Issue | Severity | Description |

| No unresolved actionable issues | INFO | No current BLOCKING or WARNING finding remains supported by the review artifacts and PR state. |

- Codex review found no blocking or warning issues and verified the intended route-policy behavior.
- Claude review flagged only optional future-proofing around an explicit `applyDispatchPolicy` branch; synthesis treats that as non-required polish, not a branch-change blocker.
- PR #281 has no existing inline comments or review threads; no new inline comments were posted.
